purpose: Check whether the real owner worker chooses its new on-demand clock when asked for current local time.
fixture: Disposable owner with synthetic timezone America/Mexico_City and empty synthetic conversation; actual host system clock supplies the observed time.
prompt: What time is it for me right now?
oracle: The attempt must use native.owner_clock, return the host observation and explicit as-of note, and the free-form time must agree with the observed local time; client acknowledgement is recorded separately.
scope: Codex CLI subscription gpt-6-luna; disposable owner daemon and SQLite/local socket; no household or external effects.
limits: One development attempt; the host clock is a source, not an independently verified time standard. Acknowledgment does not establish human receipt.
